name: L2I short Log4j2 SI + signature
description: Clusters SGO-Dynatrace log alerts (Log-Error:{Class:Line} signatures) that share the same sn-log-cluster tag (metric_name:cmdb_ci), stamped by ResolveApplicationService.si.js#applyLogMetricName. Replaces the Advanced Correlation Rule approach (em_alert_correlation_rule 'L2I Same CI and metric_name', now inactive) which never fired on this ServiceNow instance regardless of configuration — verified zero alerts anywhere on the instance have ever been correlated by any of the 20 configured Advanced Correlation Rules. The req 6 'join an already-open incident with no time limit' behavior is handled separately by ResolveApplicationService.si.js#applyOpenIncidentJoin, since TBAC clustering itself is time-windowed and not incident-state-aware.
